data.one_liner: Google Places autocomplete widgets for Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides ready-to-use widgets and dialogs for searching Google Places with autocomplete functionality. It supports overlay and fullscreen display modes, custom language settings, and component filtering.
use_when: You need a quick way to integrate Google Places search and autocomplete into your Flutter app.
You want to allow users to select addresses or locations using the Google Places API.
avoid_when: You are using a map provider other than Google Maps or require custom place providers.
You want a fully headless client without pre-built UI widgets.
strengths: Easy to set up with overlay and fullscreen modes
Supports custom styling and input decoration
Handles error callbacks and autocomplete predictions out of the box
weaknesses: Requires a valid Google Places API key and billing enabled on your Google Cloud account
data.setup_notes: Requires a Google API key and enabling billing on your Google Cloud account.
data.minimal_example:
final Prediction? p = await PlacesAutocomplete.show(
  context: context,
  apiKey: kGoogleApiKey,
  onError: (response) => print(response.errorMessage),
  mode: Mode.overlay,
  language: 'fr',
  components: [Component(Component.country, 'fr')],
);
